SELECT id, category_id, title, author, isbn, price, stock, status, cover_url, description, created_at FROM book
ORDER BY
price ASC, id DESC price DESC, id DESC title ASC, id DESC id DESC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT c.id, c.parent_id AS parentId, c.name, c.name_en AS nameEn, c.sort_weight AS sortWeight, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM book b WHERE b.status = 'ON_SHELF' AND ( b.category_id = c.id OR b.category_id IN (SELECT sc.id FROM category sc WHERE sc.parent_id = c.id) ) ) AS bookCount FROM category c WHERE c.visible = 1 ORDER BY c.sort_weight ASC, c.id ASC

SELECT b.id, b.category_id AS categoryId, c.name AS categoryName, b.title, b.author, b.isbn, b.price, b.stock, b.status, b.cover_url AS coverUrl, b.description, b.created_at AS createdAt FROM book b LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = b.category_id WHERE b.id = #{id} AND b.status = 'ON_SHELF'
